title: Upcoming end of life for the Genie One MCP Beta endpoint
body:
The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint, `https://<workspace-hostname>/api/2.0/mcp/genie`, reaches end of life on November 30, 2026. After that date, requests to the Beta endpoint fail. The end-of-life date was previously October 31, 2026.

Move all workloads to the generally available `system.ai.genie_one_mcp` MCP in Unity Gateway. See [Access through Unity Gateway](/aws/en/agents/mcp-tools/genie-mcp#access).
